fields.statement: The Orleans Grain Storage Package's declared dependencies must never include a database-platform package or project. ArgentSea.Orleans.csproj names only Microsoft Orleans packages (Microsoft.Orleans.Reminders, Microsoft.Orleans.Runtime, Microsoft.Orleans.Sdk, all pinned to 10.3.1) and a single ProjectReference to ArgentSea core (ArgentSea.Shared/src/ArgentSea.csproj); it carries no reference to SqlClient, Npgsql, ArgentSea.Sql, or ArgentSea.Pg.
fields.scope: ArgentSea.Orleans package's declared PackageReference and ProjectReference items (ArgentSea.Orleans.csproj)
